alerts.title: Tioga Road (Hwy 120 through the park) temporarily closing Wednesday at 5 pm
alerts.description: Tioga Road (continuation of Highway 120 through the park) will temporarily close on Wednesday, October 21 at 5 pm due to a forecast of snow. Call 209/372-0200 (then 1, 1) to check road conditions in the park.

alerts.title: No overnight parking on Tioga & Glacier Point Roads
alerts.description: Overnight parking is not allowed on Tioga Road and Glacier Point Road, including all parking lots reachable from these roads.
